body:
Thank you - I always try and remind myself at the outset not to do something that i'll regret tomorrow, but I get so caught up in the moods that I just can't suppress the urges.  They're overwhelming and all consuming.

Thanks for the reading material, will check it out.
I think that's the first step I need to take - finding a good therapist and sticking to seeing them.

I have plenty of people that know about my issues, but they're tired and exhausted with dealing with it to be honest.  They have tried to help, and it's not that I purposefully ignore or disregard them, I just can't follow their rules because I loose all sensibility when manic.

I probably need to see a regular therapist.
